eval.title: Apple is a GREAT BUSINESS at a ???? PRICE!!! (Adding to YT Portfolio)

call.headline_quote: well I will buy just a little bit because of the valuation and of the risks and if a great business like apple declines like it did today for uh five percent which is insane but if it declines more I will just keep adding more till we get a full position over time

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: earnings per share went from 1.59 to 6.10

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: eight percent growth rate over the next 10 years year by year if I use a seven percent discount rate and the price earnings price to cash flow ratio of 20 I get 200 intrinsic value of 130

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: if we increase the growth rates a little bit then we are 140

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: if we decrease the growth rates but this just means stagnation just growth from BuyBacks and lower the terminal multiple then we still have to see another 50 percent down

reasons.claim: Massive buybacks shrink share count and drive an extra ~3.4% annual EPS growth on top of business growth.
reasons.quote: if we divide the 85 billion spent on 2.5 trillion per year you get another buyback yield of 3.4 percent

reasons.claim: At a P/E of 25 versus his intrinsic value of 130 (below the market price), valuation is a key risk.
reasons.quote: the price earnings ratio is 25 I remember analyzing when it was 10 in 2016 so that is a risk

reasons.claim: Potential US/China sanctions over Taiwan could hit the ~30% of revenue tied to China, a major tail risk.
reasons.quote: if China bends Apple from China and related countries that's 30 percent of revenues going into dust

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: china-related revenue exposure

reasons.claim: A stable, growing ecosystem of 1.8 billion active devices with fast-growing services revenue underpins durable earnings.
reasons.quote: Services went up 12 in sales over a year ago while total revenues were two percent growth

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: active devices, services growth

reasons.claim: iPhone cycle and shifting consumer preferences create up-and-down revenue risk despite ecosystem stability.
reasons.quote: the second risk is the growth and iPhone cycle it goes up and down consumer preferences sometimes they should be good sometimes less

external_facts_used: Apple is 42% of Warren Buffett's stock market portfolio and he keeps adding, especially below $150/share
43% of sales come from Asia and about 30% of revenue is China-related
US considering sanctions to deter China from invading Taiwan; Intel CEO doubts invasion within five years
Apple was the most-traded stock in Europe on Robinhood on August 10th
Tim Cook's earnings call commentary (via Seeking Alpha transcripts) on demand and macro headwinds

critic.notes: ok — he starts a small position at $153.88 despite IV ~$130 and plans to add on declines; a cautious starter buy rather than margin-of-safety buy.
